basic_details.job_title: IIT Dharwad Inventory Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Technology Dharwad (IIT Dharwad) has invited online applications from eligible Indian citizens for 1 post of Inventory Manager [on contract] in its Materials Management Division/Stores. The engagement is initially for one year. Non-retired applicants are offered ₹ 40,000 to 65,000 per month consolidated, and retired employees are paid as per Ministry of Finance OMs. A Bachelor's Degree and at least 10 years of Materials Management Division/Stores experience are required. Applications are accepted only online at the Institute website until 27 November 2026, up to 23:59 H

how_to_apply: Apply only through the online process. The online application form and detailed instructions are on the Institute website, https://www.iitdh.ac.in/staff-recruitment.
Submit the application by 27 November 2026, up to 23:59 Hrs.

Pay the application fee of ₹ 200/- (Rupees Two hundred only), including GST, through the State Bank e-pay facility. The link is available in the online application. No other mode of payment is accepted, and payment in any other form stands forfeited.
Upload the supporting certificates and documents listed below on the online portal.
After fee payment and submission, a confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID.
Do not send a hard copy of the online application form; it is not required.
For queries about submitting the online application, applicants may email [email protected]. Queries on eligibility for the post or interpretation of rules are not entertained.

Original certificates and self-attested copies, to be produced at the time of the selection process and while joining.

content_sections.heading: About IIT Dharwad
content_sections.text: IIT Dharwad is an Institute of National Importance established by an Act of Parliament in 2016, with its address at Chikkamalligawad, Dharwad, Karnataka – 580 011. In this notice the Institute says it is looking for experienced staff who can contribute significantly to the Materials Management Division/Stores related work of the Institute.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Only eligible Indian citizens may apply. Age, qualification and experience are considered as on the last date of closing of the online interface. Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university. The qualification has to be from a recognized University/Institute. For retired employees: retired from Central Government/State Government/Central Autonomous Bodies/State Autonomous Bodies/PSU. For retired employees: at least 10 years of experience in Materials Management Division/Stores, out of which 5 years on a post with a Pay Level - 6 (7th CPC) or equivalent. For others: at least 10 years of experience in Materials Management Division/Stores, out of which 5 years on a supervisory level. Not more than 65 years as on the date of closing of the application. The notice prints no minimum age and no age relaxation. The qualification and experience listed are a bare minimum. Meeting them does not entitle an applicant to be called for test(s) and/or personal interview. Applicants should therefore give details of all qualifications and experience held in the relevant field above the minimum, with documentary evidence.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The contract engagement is initially for one year and may be renewed subject to the satisfaction of the Competent Authority. The position is purely on a contract basis. Completion of the contract does not confer any right to extension, regularization or permanency at the Institute. The selected applicant has no claim on any regular position and is not given privileges such as Housing, Medical Facility and other benefits available to regular employees of the Institute. The notice lists the terms and conditions as "As per applicability".

rows.consolidated_remuneration: Payable as per the Ministry of Finance's OMs No. 3-25/2020- E. IIIA dated 9.12.2020 and No. 3-25/2020- E. IIIA/pt dated 18-10-2023. In any other cases, 50% of the last basic pay drawn at the time of retirement is considered against paragraph 3 of the latter OM, and the rest remains unchanged.
₹ 40,000/- to 65,000/- per month [consolidated] based on experience and competency

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIT Dharwad Inventory Manager [on contract]
content_sections.text: Apply only through the online process. The online application form and detailed instructions are on the Institute website, https://www.iitdh.ac.in/staff-recruitment . Submit the application by 27 November 2026, up to 23:59 Hrs. Pay the application fee of ₹ 200/- (Rupees Two hundred only), including GST, through the State Bank e-pay facility. The link is available in the online application. No other mode of payment is accepted, and payment in any other form stands forfeited. Upload the supporting certificates and documents listed below on the online portal. After fee payment and submission, a confirmation email is sent to the registered email ID. Do not send a hard copy of the online application form; it is not required. For queries about submitting the online application, applicants may email [email protected] . Queries on eligibility for the post or interpretation of rules are not entertained. Original scanned copies of certificate(s)/document(s)/mark sheets of all semesters/years, in support of the claim on qualification (matriculation onwards), experience, date of birth, caste, category and so on. Proof of pay drawn at the time of retirement, or a copy of the PPO, wherever applicable. Experience certificate on the organization's letter head, bearing the date of issue, specific period of work, nature of duty, designation and pay drawn for each position, duly certified by the concerned issuing authority. Original certificates and self-attested copies, to be produced at the time of the selection process and while joining.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection procedure is Test/Presentation/Interview/Any other mode as decided by the Institute (or) Selection Committee. The notice gives no dates, venue or pattern for it. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of applicants called for test(s) and/or personal interview to a reasonable limit. This is done on the basis of academic performance and/or qualification and/or experience higher than the minimum prescribed. Call letters and other communication are sent by email, so a correct and active email ID is needed in the application. No TA/DA is paid for attending the selection process.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IIT Dharwad Inventory Manager recruitment?
faq.answer: There is 1 (One) post of Inventory Manager [on contract].

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for submitting the online application is 27 November 2026, up to 23:59 Hrs.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification required?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree from a recognized university is required. Retired employees and other applicants also need at least 10 years of experience in Materials Management Division/Stores, as described under Who Can Apply.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age must be not more than 65 years as on the date of closing of the application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the IIT Dharwad Inventory Manager?
faq.answer: Applicants who are not retired employees get ₹ 40,000/- to 65,000/- per month consolidated, based on experience and competency. For retired employees, remuneration is as per the Ministry of Finance OMs named in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹ 200/- including GST, paid through the State Bank e-pay facility. It is non-refundable.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for IIT Dharwad Inventory Manager?
faq.answer: Apply only online through the form on https://www.iitdh.ac.in/staff-recruitment. A hard copy of the online application form is not required.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Selection is by Test/Presentation/Interview/Any other mode as decided by the Institute (or) Selection Committee. The Institute may limit the number of applicants called if many apply.

faq.question: Q9. Is the Inventory Manager post permanent?
faq.answer: No, it is purely a contract post. It is initially for one year, may be renewed subject to the satisfaction of the Competent Authority, and gives no right to extension, regularization or permanency.

faq.question: Q10. Is TA/DA paid for attending the selection process?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid for attending the selection process.
